lead.title: Google DeepMind launches Gemini 4 Carbon, its new frontier flagship
lead.summary: Google DeepMind announced Gemini 4 Carbon, described as its strongest model yet with state-of-the-art cybersecurity and long-horizon capabilities, including reliable multi-day coding tasks. Access is initially limited to a group of cyber defenders while safety guardrails are iterated.

top_stories.title: Upwind raises $400M after walking away from a Datadog acquisition offer
top_stories.summary: The cloud and AI security platform closed a $400M Series C at a $3.8B valuation led by Bessemer Venture Partners, with revenue quadrupling in 2026. The round funds product development and go-to-market expansion.

top_stories.title: Study: roughly 24% of crawlable web pages now contain AI-generated text
top_stories.summary: An analysis of over 5 million pages between 2019 and 2026 estimates about 24% carried AI-generated or AI-edited text by August 2026, with growth accelerating. The rise concentrates on low-authority 'edge' pages, while .gov/.edu domains remain far cleaner.

top_stories.title: Tencent open-sources Hy-Nomas, a free-form interactive world generation model
top_stories.summary: Tencent's Hunyuan team open-sourced Hy-Nomas, an interactive world generation model positioned as comparable to DeepMind's Genie 4. It ships with a Hugging Face paper, a Space demo, and a public playable demo with no waitlist.

top_stories.title: Amazon unveils EMMA, a self-improving multi-agent framework
top_stories.summary: EMMA treats routing memory, agent prompts and skills as episodic memory, with a reflector assigning scoped fixes after failures. It reportedly outperforms ACE, GEPA, EvoMAS and ADAS by up to 32.5% while using 17–38% fewer training executions.

items.title: A scaling law for tool-use agents, from 849 models trained in synthetic environments
items.summary: SynthAPI is a pipeline for synthetically generating tool-use environments, and the paper derives scaling laws showing how data composition in these environments drives multi-step tool-use agent performance.

items.title: Timestral: four time-series foundation models sweep forecasting benchmarks
items.summary: A family of four forecasting models (5M–209M parameters) sets a new state of the art on GIFT-Eval, TIME and fev-bench, with the 209M and 123M variants taking the top two spots on every metric.

items.title: Metacognitive decoding makes diffusion language agents cheaper to run
items.summary: A metacognitive controller for diffusion language models adaptively allocates computation and controls generation length, improving the efficiency of parallel-token agent inference.

items.title: Label-free RLVR improves reasoning, then collapses
items.summary: The paper shows self-reinforcing RLVR initially improves reasoning but eventually collapses: self-assessed reward saturates while accuracy falls, often degenerating to a single answer across all questions.

items.title: MuonGS: relaxed weight-norm control improves LLM pretraining
items.summary: An analysis of weight-norm control in the Muon optimizer across the full training trajectory yields relaxed norm-constraint schemes that improve pretraining performance.

items.title: Altera launches Agilex 27, first FPGA family in its new Agilex 2X portfolio
items.summary: The Agilex 27 pairs hardened 800GbE and 1.6TbE Ethernet with PCIe 6.0 and 7.0 support and configurable transceivers up to 256 Gbps for bandwidth-intensive datapath, beamforming and RF workloads.

items.title: CXMT to start HBM3E mass production by end of 2026
items.summary: The Chinese memory maker said it will begin mass production of HBM3E by the end of 2026, a notable step for the domestic AI chip supply chain as it also enters LPDDR6 risk production with 12.8 Gbps chips.

items.title: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5080 reaches nearly $2,000 across U.S. retailers
items.summary: The card is now listed at close to $2,000 at Best Buy, Micro Center, Amazon, Newegg and B&H — well above MSRP — reflecting persistent pricing pressure amid AI-driven demand.

items.title: Local Code: run DeepSeek 4.1 Flash coding models fully locally on Macs
items.summary: Draw Things released Local Code, an open-source community project to run DeepSeek 4.1 Flash coding models entirely on Apple Silicon.

items.title: A full Python 3.15 implemented in 25,000 lines of C11
items.summary: A Show HN project presents a complete Python 3.15 interpreter written from scratch in roughly 25,000 lines of C11, an unusually compact independent implementation.

items.title: Enframe wraps any OpenAPI spec into an MCP server
items.summary: Enframe is a drop-in sidecar that turns any existing OpenAPI specification into a Model Context Protocol server, making legacy APIs agent-ready.

items.title: Fengarde: OCSF-native open-source SIEM with local AI triage
items.summary: An Apache-2.0 licensed, OCSF-native open-source SIEM that performs alert triage with locally running AI models.

items.title: Tilde: an open-source registry for discovering and sharing AI agents
items.summary: Tilde (~) is a new open-source registry for AI agents, launched as a Show HN project.

quick_hits.title: LMSYS, AMD and the Miles team train Qwen3-30B-A3B with fully asynchronous agentic RL
quick_hits.summary: SWE-bench Verified pass@1 jumped from 7.3% to 27.5% after SFT + RL, with 3x faster RL steps and ~4x rollout throughput using SGLang, Megatron-LM and Harbor.

quick_hits.title: Politecnico di Milano's HumanTech program targets sustainable AI in industry
quick_hits.summary: Over 80 projects on AI systems studying emotions and fatigue, and robots working alongside people, aimed at safer industrial digitalization.
